name: mail-send
description: The subject method sends mail through Spring's JavaMailSender or MailSender, or Jakarta Mail's Transport. The mail server is not named here: it comes from the config (spring.mail.host), which the linker reads (ADR 0076).

template.description: The binary name of the type whose method sends, such as org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender.

method.description: The name of the method called, such as send.
